_comment_IMAGE_BACKBONE: Changing this requires retraining from scratch.
_comment_TEXT_ENCODER: Any valid HuggingFace model identifier is accepted.
_comment_TEXT_POOLING: How to pool transformer token representations into a single vector.
Weight each token by its average self-attention score from the
encoder's final layer, then take a weighted sum.
Tokens the model already focuses on (keywords, prices, brand names)
contribute more. Padding tokens get near-zero weight automatically.
No extra parameters - uses the encoder's own learned attention.
Better than CLS for most tasks. Slight noise from low-importance tokens.
Fast. Standard for BERT sentence classification.
Issue 7 fix: attention_weighted pooling implemented and set as default.
_comment_FUSION_TYPE: How to fuse visual and text features. Options:
attention : RECOMMENDED - full bidirectional cross-modal MHA.
Visual attends to text AND text attends to visual.
Both modalities keep their native dimensions until fusion.
concat    : concatenate native vectors -> Linear(v_dim+t_dim, HIDDEN_DIM).
Simple and fast, no attention parameters.
Change this key only - no code changes needed.
_comment_HIDDEN_DIM: Output dimension of the shared FC and all classification heads.
This is NOT the dimension of the visual or text encoders - those
keep their native dimensions (e.g. 2048 for ResNet-50, 768 for BERT).
The projection to HIDDEN_DIM happens AFTER cross-modal attention,
so no information is discarded before the modalities interact.
_comment_ATTENTION_DIM: Internal Q/K/V dimension for cross-modal attention.
Both visual (e.g. 2048) and text (e.g. 768) are projected to this
dimension before multi-head attention is computed.
768 = native DistilBERT/BERT dimension, so text is not compressed at all.
Visual (2048->768) is still compressed but unavoidable.
If you switch to bert-large (native_dim=1024), set ATTENTION_DIM=1024.
Rule of thumb: ATTENTION_DIM >= text encoder native_dim.
_comment_ATTENTION_HEADS: Number of attention heads in cross-modal MHA.
Must divide ATTENTION_DIM evenly: ATTENTION_DIM % ATTENTION_HEADS == 0.
Each head operates on ATTENTION_DIM / ATTENTION_HEADS = 64 dims.
_comment_DROPOUT: Dropout probability in [0, 1). Raised from 0.3 → 0.4 to combat overfitting (train/val gap visible by epoch 11 with 4860 training samples).
_comment_FREEZE_BACKBONE: If true, freeze the pretrained visual backbone convolutional weights.
The new projection head (fc/classifier) always remains trainable.
BUG-23 FIX: previously froze the head too, preventing it from training.
_comment_DEEP_SHARED_LAYER: If true, use a two-layer shared FC after fusion:
If false, use a single layer: fusion_dim -> HIDDEN_DIM
_comment_ATTRIBUTE_LOSS_WEIGHTS: Per-attribute multiplier applied to each head's CrossEntropyLoss before summing.
be learned from image+text content (confirmed by Cramér's V ≈ 0.02–0.04).
Reducing them to 0.1 (from 0.3) almost silences their gradient noise,
letting the semantic heads (sentiment, emotion, trust_safety) dominate.
Used by train_epoch in train_model.py — see ATTRIBUTE_LOSS_WEIGHTS key.
_comment_image_size: Input image size as [width, height]. Must match what the backbone expects.
BUG-09 FIX: image/pipeline.py now uses this value (not a hardcoded 224).
Used by: transforms.py, pipeline.py, evaluate.py, predict_image.py, analyze_model.py
_comment_use_text: Set to false to disable the text branch entirely.
_comment_text_max_length: Maximum token sequence length for the text encoder.
Must be consistent across training, validation, and inference.
BUG-05/10 FIX: all code now reads this value from config.
Used by: pipeline.py, train_model.py script, evaluate.py, predict_image.py, tokenizer.py
_comment_DATASET_ROOT: Optional path to the dataset root for training and evaluation.
If set, the code resolves splits from this directory instead of
Use an absolute path such as the Kaggle input path.
_comment_training_note: IMPORTANT: These keys must be at the TOP LEVEL of this file.
Do NOT nest them under a 'model' key.
BUG-28 NOTE: setup_training_components reads from the top-level config.
_comment_learning_rate: LR for randomly initialised layers (heads, projection, shared FC). Raised from 1e-4 → 3e-4.
_comment_encoder_learning_rate: LR for the pretrained text encoder (text_module.encoder).
Should be ~10-25x lower than learning_rate to avoid catastrophic forgetting.
Raised from 5e-6 → 2e-5: the encoder was barely fine-tuning at 5e-6.
_comment_weight_decay: L2 regularisation applied to non-bias, non-LayerNorm parameters.
Raised from 1e-3 → 5e-3 to combat overfitting on small dataset (4860 samples).
Bias and LayerNorm weights always have weight_decay=0 (standard BERT recipe).
BUG-02 FIX: no longer passed as a global AdamW arg (was redundant).
_comment_batch_size: With DataParallel (multi-GPU) each GPU processes batch_size/num_gpus samples.
Doubled from 32 → 64 to use both T4 GPUs effectively (32 samples/GPU).
Larger batches also stabilise gradient estimates with only 4860 training samples.
BUG-07 FIX: train DataLoader uses drop_last=True so the last batch
is never smaller than batch_size (prevents BatchNorm crash on batch=1).
_comment_num_workers: Number of DataLoader worker processes for data loading.
Higher values help keep multiple GPUs fed with data.
Set to 0 to load data in the main process (useful for debugging).
Capped to available CPU count at runtime.
_comment_warmup_epochs: Number of linear LR warmup epochs at the start of training.
LR ramps from near-zero to learning_rate over this many epochs.
Reduced from 15 → 5: with only 4860 samples, 15 warmup epochs means the
LR didn't peak until epoch 15, at which point val loss was already rising.
5 epochs gives stable early gradients without delaying convergence.
BUG-01 FIX: warmup is handled by SequentialLR+LinearLR in pipeline.py.
_comment_mixup_alpha: Mixup Beta distribution parameter. 0 disables Mixup.
Set to 0: multi-task training with 9 conflicting label sets makes Mixup harmful.
A mixed image of 'Food' and 'Tech' ads has no valid joint labels.
Standard image augmentation (already configured) is sufficient.
_comment_label_smoothing: Redistributes 10% of the probability mass uniformly across all classes,
preventing overconfident predictions on small datasets.
Particularly helpful when val loss diverges from train loss (as seen at epoch 11).
_comment_early_stopping_patience: Stop training if val accuracy does not improve for this many consecutive epochs.
Reduced from 15 → 10: with the train/val gap already opening at epoch 11,
15 patience epochs wastes compute on a diverging run.
Set to 0 to disable early stopping.
_comment_checkpoint_dir: Directory to save model checkpoints during training.
Best checkpoints are saved as best_model_epoch_N_acc_X.pt.
Last epoch checkpoint is saved as last_model.pt.
_comment_log_dir: Directory to store training logs (CSV of per-epoch metrics).
_comment_scheduler_type: LR decay schedule after warmup. Options:
cosine : CosineAnnealingLR from warmup_end to epoch N (recommended)
step   : StepLR - multiply LR by scheduler_gamma every scheduler_step_size epochs
_comment_scheduler_eta_min: Minimum LR for cosine scheduler. Only used when scheduler_type = 'cosine'.
_comment_scheduler_step_size: Decay interval in epochs. Only used when scheduler_type = 'step'.
_comment_scheduler_gamma: LR multiplier per step. Only used when scheduler_type = 'step'.
_comment_class_weights_note: BUG-25 FIX: If this key is absent, weights are auto-computed from the
training CSV using inverse-frequency: weight[i] = total / (num_classes * count[i]).
Set to {} to explicitly disable weighting.
Set to a dict of lists to use fixed weights (overrides auto-computation).

color_jitter._comment_brightness: Raised from 0.15 → 0.3: stronger colour augmentation helps generalise dominant_colour head.
_comment_hue: BUG-13 FIX: now performs a real HSV hue rotation (not additive RGB shift).

augmentation._comment_crop_scale: Widened from [0.95,1.0] → [0.85,1.0]: more crop variation improves spatial robustness.
